title.zh: 把活动的吸引力与一个想练的环节并列
title.en: Place the appeal beside one part you would practise

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的短声音片段，先分别想想哪一处让你有兴趣、哪一段停顿值得尝试。可以只想象，也可以做一个不需公开的小片段；试后觉得不喜欢，同样是关于这次活动的新信息。复盘不把喜欢当成擅长，不要求作品、观众或收入，也不用继续练习来证明结果。其他视角仍可另读，未先选它们不说明生活缺少某个圈。
paragraphs.en: For the short sound passage above, separate what interests you from a pause you would try placing. Imagine it or make a private fragment; discovering that it does not appeal is information about this activity too. Review without equating enjoyment with skill or requiring a product, audience or income. Continuing practice need not prove the result. Other guides remain available, and not choosing them first establishes no missing circle in your life.

title.zh: 围绕一件小事交换探索问题
title.en: Exchange exploration questions about one small activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只是试一个声音片段，什么让你想试，哪个小环节想练，而哪些事情这次不必证明？”分享想先了解的问题即可，不用替彼此发现命定目标、判断能力、推荐工作或衡量人生价值。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For a short sound passage, what would attract you, what small part would you practise and what need not be proved this time?” Share what you would explore first without discovering a destined purpose, judging ability, recommending work or measuring the value of a life.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。对方可以换一个视角、不回答或结束，不需公开收入、职业计划、他人的需要或私人经历，也不用再做测试才能交流。
paragraphs.en: You can share this public guide; its link contains no answers or counts. The other person may choose another lens, decline or stop without disclosing income, work plans, others’ needs or private experiences, or taking a test to join.

title.zh: 让自己愿意提供的部分与明确请求对齐
title.en: Compare what you want to offer with the stated request

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的活动说明难找，先区分自己喜欢整理哪部分，以及朋友实际希望找到什么。可以只提出整理几条公开信息，问这是否符合请求；对方拒绝或另有偏好时，保留这个回应。愿意帮助不证明已经帮上忙，也不产生持续服务的义务。复盘看范围与意愿是否说清，不以付出多少、被需要程度或下次计数更高来证明使命感。
paragraphs.en: For the hard-to-find activity instructions above, distinguish the part you enjoy organising from what the friend actually wants to locate. Offer a few public details and ask whether that fits; retain a refusal or different preference. Wanting to help proves no benefit and creates no continuing service obligation. Review scope and willingness without using effort spent, being needed or a higher count as proof of a mission.

title.zh: 围绕一件小事交换探索问题
title.en: Exchange exploration questions about one small activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友只想找到活动时间，你愿意整理哪部分，怎样确认没有把自己的大计划替代对方的小请求？”分享想先了解的问题即可，不用替彼此发现命定目标、判断能力、推荐工作或衡量人生价值。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend only wanted the activity time, what would you enjoy organising and how could you keep your larger plan from replacing that small request?” Share what you would explore first without discovering a destined purpose, judging ability, recommending work or measuring the value of a life.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。对方可以换一个视角、不回答或结束，不需公开收入、职业计划、他人的需要或私人经历，也不用再做测试才能交流。
paragraphs.en: You can share this public guide; its link contains no answers or counts. The other person may choose another lens, decline or stop without disclosing income, work plans, others’ needs or private experiences, or taking a test to join.

title.zh: 把练习样例与尚未承诺的交付分开
title.en: Separate a practice sample from an unpromised delivery

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的公开资料索引，分别写清一页小样可能展示什么、实际交付还需确认什么，以及目前完全未知的条件。可以只练习而不承接工作，也可以先决定是否愿意让这件事涉及报酬。小样不证明稳定能力，设想付款也不等于已有需求或收入。复盘只辨认练习与交付之间的信息缺口，不由计数推荐职业、定价或要求把爱好变成工作。
paragraphs.en: For the public-material index above, distinguish what a one-page sample might show, what actual delivery would need confirmed and what remains unknown. Practise without accepting work, or first decide whether payment belongs in the activity at all. A sample proves no stable competence, and imagined payment establishes neither demand nor income. Review the information gap between practice and delivery without using a count for career recommendations, pricing or a requirement to turn a hobby into work.

title.zh: 围绕一件小事交换探索问题
title.en: Exchange exploration questions about one small activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只是试做一页公开资料索引，小样能说明什么，哪些交付条件仍不能据此承诺？”分享想先了解的问题即可，不用替彼此发现命定目标、判断能力、推荐工作或衡量人生价值。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If you tried one page of a public-material index, what could the sample show and which delivery conditions could not yet be promised?” Share what you would explore first without discovering a destined purpose, judging ability, recommending work or measuring the value of a life.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。对方可以换一个视角、不回答或结束，不需公开收入、职业计划、他人的需要或私人经历，也不用再做测试才能交流。
paragraphs.en: You can share this public guide; its link contains no answers or counts. The other person may choose another lens, decline or stop without disclosing income, work plans, others’ needs or private experiences, or taking a test to join.

title.zh: 把需要、支持与愿意承担的范围分别确认
title.en: Check the need, support and scope you would accept separately

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的活动指引，先问使用者实际需要哪部分，再区分时间、场地或报酬等支持有哪些已确认、哪些待讨论。另列自己愿意与能够提供的范围；需要存在不等于必须接受，有支持也不证明活动合适。可以缩小、暂缓或不参与。复盘保留这些不同问题，不以被需要、得到报酬或四项计数相同证明找到天职、理想中心或完整人生。
paragraphs.en: For the activity directions above, identify what users actually need, then distinguish confirmed time, space or payment support from arrangements still open. Separately retain what you want and are able to offer. A need creates no duty to accept, and support establishes no suitable fit. Narrow, postpone or decline participation. Review these separate questions without using demand, payment or four equal counts to certify a calling, ideal centre or complete life.

title.zh: 围绕一件小事交换探索问题
title.en: Exchange exploration questions about one small activity

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果有人需要一份活动指引，哪些需要已说清，哪些支持还未确认，怎样保留自己不参与的选择？”分享想先了解的问题即可，不用替彼此发现命定目标、判断能力、推荐工作或衡量人生价值。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If someone needed activity directions, which needs would be clear, what support would remain unconfirmed and how could you retain the choice not to participate?” Share what you would explore first without discovering a destined purpose, judging ability, recommending work or measuring the value of a life.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。对方可以换一个视角、不回答或结束，不需公开收入、职业计划、他人的需要或私人经历，也不用再做测试才能交流。
paragraphs.en: You can share this public guide; its link contains no answers or counts. The other person may choose another lens, decline or stop without disclosing income, work plans, others’ needs or private experiences, or taking a test to join.
